typeProperties.script:
source(output(
		{Last Name} as string,
		{First Name} as string,
		MI as string,
		{Address 1} as string,
		{Address 2} as string,
		City as string,
		State as string,
		Zip as string,
		Phone as string,
		Medicaid_no as string,
		DOB as string,
		Gender as string,
		MBI as string,
		{Medicaid MCO} as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'SELECT [Last Name] ,[First Name] ,[MI] ,[Address 1] ,[Address 2] ,[City] ,[State] ,[Zip] ,[Phone] ,[Medicaid_no] ,[DOB] ,[Gender] ,[MBI] ,[Medicaid MCO] FROM EXTRACT.LA_DSNP_MEMBER_ENROLLMENT_STAGING',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> OLEDBSource
OLEDBSource derive({Last Name} = {Last Name}) ~> PlaceHolderRowCount
PlaceHolderRowCount derive({Copy of MBI} = toString(MBI),
		{Copy of DOB} = DOB,
		{Copy of Medicaid_no} = toString(Medicaid_no),
		{Copy of City} = toString(City),
		{Copy of Gender} = toString(Gender),
		{Copy of Phone} = toString(Phone),
		{Copy of State} = toString(State),
		{Copy of Zip} = toString(Zip),
		{Copy of MI} = toString(MI)) ~> DataConversion
DataConversion sink(input(
		{} as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> ExcelDestination
